name.zh: 连续枕瓣枕状熔岩教学露头

description.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: interlocking bulbous lobes with constricted necks and cooling skins. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants.
description.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：膨鼓枕状叶瓣通过细颈相连并带冷却外壳。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。

sources.title: Lava Flows
sources.supports: Lava surface and flow architecture; style depends on eruption conditions
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original lofts vary lobe size, elongation, neck width and curvature before soft union. Restrained skin channels converge around inflated ends; bounded flat cut is a teaching presentation choice. Colors, nominal dimensions and simplified layout are artistic. Shape alone is not a field diagnosis proving submarine origin; no exact site or date reconstruction.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创放样先变化流瓣大小、伸长、颈宽和曲率，再柔和连接。克制的冷却表皮沟纹在膨鼓端附近汇合；有界平裁底面是教学展示选择。配色、名义尺寸及简化布局为美术选择。仅凭造型不能作证实海底成因的野外诊断，不复原精确地点或年代。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
